ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
pyngrok is a Python wrapper for ngrok that provides programmatic tunnels for ingress, webhooks, demos, and APIs. It
downloads and manages the ngrok agent for you, making it available through a Python API and the command line. It
runs anywhere the ngrok agent does. The library is mature and stable, and it tracks new ngrok releases.

name: pyngrok
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "pyngrok" %}
{% set version = "9.0.2" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: c4aeb236d6c9b22da747b550a2753f8e73aff48ecba883729f3c5acef212d19e

build:
  noarch: python
  entry_points:
    - ngrok=pyngrok.ngrok:main
    - pyngrok=pyngrok.ngrok:main
  number: 0
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - PyYAML >=6.0.3

test:
  imports:
    - pyngrok
  commands:
    - pip check
    - ngrok --help
    - pyngrok --help
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/alexdlaird/pyngrok
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: A Python wrapper for ngrok; programmatic tunnels for ingress, webhooks, demos, and APIs
  description: |
    pyngrok is a Python wrapper for ngrok that provides programmatic tunnels for ingress, webhooks, demos, and APIs. It
    downloads and manages the ngrok agent for you, making it available through a Python API and the command line. It
    runs anywhere the ngrok agent does. The library is mature and stable, and it tracks new ngrok releases.
  doc_url: https://pyngrok.readthedocs.io/
  dev_url: https://github.com/alexdlaird/pyngrok

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - alexdlaird
